title: Heinrich Weber: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-05-29 Weber author record with Volume II tail and Volume III sections 1-14 literal repair
description:
Author record for Heinrich Weber in the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. The page keeps broad working readers for Lehrbuch der Algebra while a source-checkable literal repair stream replaces the weaker Volume II translation draft section by section.

Status at a glance. [########--] broad draft available; literal repair stream now covers Volume II tail material plus Volume III sections 1-14 as paired German source and English translation readers. Volumes I and III have original-language modern LaTeX readers, and Volume I also has an English working reader.

The artifact ZIP preserves TeX sources, component PDFs, earlier section pairs, provenance notes, and source material for continued checking.
notes: Latest update replaces the previous Volume III sections 1-6 pair with a cleaner paired source/translation reader that extends through Volume III sections 1-14.
